q14.

**ShortcutService** is defined in `proto/api/v1/shortcut_service.proto` (line 14) and declares **5 RPCs**:

| # | RPC name | 
|---|---|
| 1 | `ListShortcuts` |
| 2 | `GetShortcut` |
| 3 | `CreateShortcut` |
| 4 | `UpdateShortcut` |
| 5 | `DeleteShortcut` |

**Implementing file:** `server/router/api/v1/shortcut_service.go`

This file contains the real business logic on the `APIV1Service` struct (lines 49, 95, 135, 211, 284).

There is also a thin Connect-RPC adapter layer in `server/router/api/v1/connect_services.go` (lines 528–560), where `ConnectServiceHandler` delegates each RPC to `APIV1Service`. So the actual implementation lives in `shortcut_service.go`, with `connect_services.go` acting as a transport-layer shim.
